title: Independent insurance agency or marketing organization: mortgage protection, life insurance, annuities, agent recruiting (YMYL, regulated advertising)
jurisdiction: US federal + the NAIC model rules. Insurance advertising is regulated state by state: each state adopts its own version of the NAIC models, so every item below is a floor to confirm against the states the agency is licensed in. Another state: add its pattern under licencePatterns and keep the item ids.
sources: NAIC Advertisements of Life Insurance and Annuities Model Regulation #570 (state-adopted versions differ; section numbers UNVERIFIED, confirm with compliance)
NAIC Unfair Trade Practices Act #880, misrepresentation and false advertising (UNVERIFIED, confirm with compliance: section and the state's adopted text)
NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation #245 (number recalled; UNVERIFIED, confirm with compliance)
NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation #275 (number recalled; UNVERIFIED, confirm with compliance)
NAIC Life Insurance Illustrations Model Regulation #582 (number recalled; UNVERIFIED, confirm with compliance)
Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act privacy provisions (15 U.S.C. 6801 et seq.) and NAIC Privacy of Consumer Financial and Health Information Regulation #672 (number recalled; UNVERIFIED)
FTC Act section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45), deceptive acts or practices
FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising (16 CFR Part 255)
FTC Guide Concerning Use of the Word "Free" (16 CFR Part 251)
FTC Business Opportunity Rule (16 CFR Part 437; whether it applies to an agency's agent programme depends on whether agents pay for the opportunity: UNVERIFIED, confirm with counsel)
TCPA (47 U.S.C. 227) and FCC rules (47 CFR 64.1200): prior express (written) consent for marketing calls and texts
Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines: insurance and annuities are YMYL (Your Money or Your Life); E-E-A-T applies, trust is the most important member

Google Search Central structured data guidelines: review markup must come from real, visible reviews, and self-serving reviews on LocalBusiness/Organization pages are not eligible for review rich results
Compiled from recalled knowledge on 2026-10-23; no source page was re-fetched. A rule whose basis says UNVERIFIED must be confirmed with compliance counsel before it is relied on. Not legal advice.
notes: Items with severity warn are reported as WARN and fail only under --strict (launch). A business waives an item with --waive <id> when its own sign-off lifts the rule. The business values come from business.json credentials {state, licenseNumber, agencyLegalName}. Item types: licence-on-every-page, business-text-on-every-page, forbidden-phrases, required-pages (as in the other packs) and, new with this pack, required-when-present (a statement that must appear on a page that makes a claim, has a form, or sits under pathPattern; nearChars = within that many characters of the claim; 'any occurrence' is enough) and forbidden-schema (JSON-LD @type names). pageTypes feeds plan-site.mjs (schema per page kind, plannerKind); seeds.queries feeds research-seeds.mjs --industry insurance-agency. Variable annuities, RILAs and funds are securities: out of scope, INS-INV-001 flags them.

pageTypes.description: Home: the agency as a local FinancialService entity (InsuranceAgency), with name, url, telephone, areaServed, sameAs; no offers or prices

One page per product line (mortgage protection, term life, permanent life, indexed universal life, fixed annuity, fixed indexed annuity, income annuity): Service with serviceType and provider = the agency; FAQPage added when the page shows 2+ real questions; no Product, Offer, price or rate markup
A page for a state or city only where the agency and the producer are licensed and have real local content (areaServed); never swapped-name doorway pages

Educational guide or comparison (mortgage protection vs PMI, fixed vs fixed indexed annuity, term vs permanent): Article with author, datePublished and dateModified; named author, licensed reviewer and last-reviewed date shown on the page
Hub that links the product-line and area pages

Agent recruiting page: WebPage (JobPosting only for a real employee posting, not an independent-contractor opportunity); earnings disclaimer, licence requirement, engagement and cost statements; no income promises
Quote or contact form page (ContactPage if it is only a contact form): consent language beside the form, privacy link, no Product/Offer
About, team and licensing page: each producer named with licence number and NPN, states of licence, carriers appointed, how the agency is paid; Person nodes only for people shown on the page

seeds.note: Recalled demand, no volume and no ranking; the owner approves the list and research measures it. {city} expands per service-area city in business.json; national queries stay as they are. Local pages only for states and cities where the agency is licensed.
